learn.plain: A fab is a giant kitchen that repeats one recipe hundreds of times: add a layer, print a pattern, carve it, fill it, polish it, check it. It must be far cleaner than a hospital and more precise than almost anything else people manufacture.
learn.engineer: Process control relies on statistical process control, run-to-run feedback and fault detection on every chamber. Key loops include per-field lithography corrections for dimensions and overlay using high-order wafer and field models, etch endpoint detection, ALD saturation curves, and CMP removal following Preston's law (rate proportional to pressure times velocity) with dummy fill to limit dishing. Cycle time is roughly 1 to 1.5 days per mask layer.

quiz.q: Why are cleanrooms so strict about particles?
options: One particle can short wires or block a pattern on a die
quiz.why: A 0.1 µm particle is about twice the spacing between transistor gates.

quiz.q: What makes ALD different from CVD?
options: Each cycle adds one self-limiting atomic layer, coating deep trenches evenly
quiz.why: ALD is slow but nearly perfectly conformal, which modern transistors need.
